summary: Comprehensive testing of 2 new features: Plan Management and Payment Settings. Backend: 16/16 tests passed (100%). Frontend: All UI flows working correctly. Fixed 1 bug in OwnerControls.js (SelectItem empty value causing runtime error).
passed_tests: 1. PLAN MANAGEMENT - Owner login, navigate to /admin, click Users tab - Plan badges clickable ✓
2. PLAN CHANGE FLOW - Click plan badge → dialog opens with current plan, select dropdown, impact preview ✓
3. PLAN CHANGE - Select Free → Premium, confirm shows credits will change to 500, toast 'Plan updated to PREMIUM' ✓
4. PLAN DEMOTE FLOW - Change Premium → Free, credits reset to 50, audit log created ✓
5. PLAN CHANGE VALIDATION - Same plan selected shows warning 'User is already on this plan', Confirm button disabled ✓
6. PAYMENT SETTINGS TAB - Owner Controls > Payment Settings loads with Razorpay Key ID, masked secret, Active toggle ON ✓
7. PAYMENT SETTINGS - Stripe and PayPal show 'COMING SOON' in Supported Gateways section ✓
8. PAYMENT SETTINGS SAVE - Enter new keys, click Save, success toast, settings persisted ✓
9. PAYMENT SETTINGS TEST CONNECTION - Click Test Connection, loading state, connection status shows (error expected for demo keys) ✓
10. AUDIT LOGS - plan_changed and payment_settings_updated entries appear in Owner Controls > Audit Logs ✓
11. ROLE PERMISSIONS - Admin can see Users tab but plan change ↕ button NOT shown (only owners can change plans) ✓
12. NON-OWNER ACCESS - Admin navigating to /owner redirects to /dashboard ✓
13. BACKEND - Owner can view all users via /api/admin/users ✓
14. BACKEND - Owner can change user plan via PUT /api/admin/users/{id}/plan ✓
15. BACKEND - Owner can get/update payment settings via /api/owner/payment-settings ✓
16. BACKEND - Admin blocked from payment settings (403) ✓

bugs_fixed.issue: SelectItem with empty string value causing 'Uncaught runtime errors' in Audit Logs tab
bugs_fixed.fix: Changed SelectItem value from empty string '' to 'all' and updated onValueChange handler to convert 'all' back to empty string for API filtering

seed_data_creation: Multiple TEST_ prefixed users created during backend testing for plan change tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: Two new features tested and working: 1) Plan Management in Admin Dashboard Users tab - owner can click plan badges or ↕ icon to change user plans with confirmation dialog, auto-credit update, and audit logging. 2) Payment Settings in Owner Controls - owner can update Razorpay keys dynamically without server restart. Test Connection shows 'Authentication failed' for demo keys (expected). Audit Logs filter fixed (was crashing due to empty SelectItem value).
